explanation: In the United States, the thumbs-up gesture is widely understood as a sign of approval, agreement, or encouragement in everyday contexts. It is commonly used in casual conversation, social media, and even some professional settings without causing offense.
local_tip: Use the thumbs-up freely in casual interactions, but avoid it in very formal or solemn situations where verbal communication is more appropriate.

also_check.note: Considered an insult similar to the middle finger, especially when thrust upward.
Equivalent to an obscene gesture, akin to showing the middle finger.
Often interpreted as a rude or insulting gesture, especially in the northern regions.
